purpose: Require ordered exact-package assurance, hostile tests, relocation, and external release boundaries.
rules: Run E0 through E7 in order against one unchanged evaluator package digest.
Require schema, projection, lifecycle, isolation, orchestration, role, scoring, statistics, evidence, learning, portability, and forward evidence.
A changed byte creates a new assurance lineage and invalidates prior package identity.
The package never holds issuer signing keys or trust-policy mutation authority.
An assurance certificate and recommendation are evidence, not release credentials.
